why: I checked both items on the must_not list, and neither brief does either one. (1) Verifier Check 6 bases PASS/FAIL on "npm test; echo \"exit=$?\"" and a grep of test/*.js. `npm run test:cli` doesn't appear anywhere in either brief, even though the issue's proof uses it. No other check depends on it. (2) The builder brief never asks for a general separator option. It only checks for `--tsv` in process.argv and calls `parse(text, '\t')`. It names "a general --sep/--delimiter option" only under "Out of scope." The verifier mentions --sep/--delimiter only in an advisory note that says to flag such an option as an out-of-scope change.
